question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Miscellaneous
solution:
The correct answer is "**Various**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Miscellaneous" means consisting of many different types or things.** (विविध)

 
 
• Example: He picked up the miscellaneous papers from the tray.
 
 
 
• **"Various" means different kinds or types, diverse.** (विभिन्न)
 
 
• ​Example: There are various ways to complete the task.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the synonym of Miscellaneous is Various.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, Contemporary means modern or current.(समकालीन)
 
• Option 3, Virtuous means having high moral standards or being morally excellent.(धार्मिक)
 
• Option 4, Interesting means arousing curiosity or attention. (दिलचस्प)
